What are Big Bets?

Big Bets are time-limited investments in grantmaking with the potential for transformative change.

AI Opportunity

Expanding who creates, uses, and benefits from artificial intelligence.

Climate Solutions

Ensuring that the Earth stays well below a two-degrees Celsius temperature increase to avoid catastrophic global effects.

Criminal Justice

Addressing over-incarceration and racial and ethnic disparities by changing the way America thinks about and uses jails.

Local News

Revitalizing local news to better inform communities and strengthen American democracy.

Other Areas of Work How does MacArthur Work? 

Unwavering, deep, and longstanding trust of the people doing the work.

Advancing the world’s ingenuity by supporting the creative problem-solvers of our time.

Connecting the people working toward a more just, verdant, and peaceful world.

Our work is carried out with a sense of urgency through a range of philanthropic and adaptive approaches that enable us to apply what we are learning.

  • Technology in the Public Interest

What is Field Support?

We make grants and investments to strengthen and build fields that are essential to our effectiveness. These grants, investments, and related activities contribute to the knowledge, understanding, and structures of a field to ensure that we support work to maximize the Foundation's impact.

Impact Investments

Building the field of impact investing and providing catalytic capital to address social and environmental challenges around the world.

Philanthropy

Supporting a variety of organizations that are devoted to improving the practice of philanthropy, strengthening the sector, and advocating and defending the sector at the local, state, and national levels.

Technology in the Public Interest

Advancing equity and justice by strengthening an ecosystem of people, organizations, and networks examining and addressing the social impacts of technology.
